title: Mocha Protein Smoothie
subtitle: Coffee · Coffee
description: Cold brew, cocoa, and yogurt give you coffee-shop flavor without the drive-thru sugar bomb. Popular on tours that start early and stay loud.
intro: Cold brew, cocoa, and yogurt give you coffee-shop flavor without the drive-thru sugar bomb. Popular on tours that start early and stay loud.

ingredients.name: cold brew coffee
ingredients.notes: chilled or ice cubes + strong coffee

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Mocha Protein Smoothie in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Use honey or maple syrup as listed — measure each before heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Blend. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Blend yogurt, milk, cocoa,
steps.instruction: Blend yogurt, milk, cocoa, and coffee until the cocoa is fully dissolved — no dry cocoa pockets. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Add banana or protein
steps.instruction: Add banana or protein powder if using. Blend until frothy on top, about 60 seconds. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Taste before adding sweetener
steps.instruction: Taste before adding sweetener — coffee bitterness varies batch to batch. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Serve over ice if
steps.instruction: Serve over ice if you want it colder; foam on top is normal from the yogurt. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

substitutions: Instant espresso (2 tsp + ½ cup water) works if cold brew is not stocked.
Skip protein powder if the crew prefers whole-food protein only.
shiftNote: Caffeine plus protein in one cup — useful when the pot is empty but the board is not.
proTips: Caffeine plus protein in one cup — useful when the pot is empty but the board is not.
Rinse the blender jar between batches so flavors do not muddy the next crew's cups.
If tones drop during service, cover hot food and hold at 140°F — note hold time on the pan for food safety.
tonightSpread: Pour Mocha Protein Smoothie into insulated cups or quart jars on ice for grab-and-go service.
Set granola, nut butter, and extra fruit in side bowls so crew can customize without slowing the line.
Keep a backup blender batch chilled at 38°F if service runs past 20 minutes.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
